oneSentenceStory: The customer views their current LBG coin balance and directly applies accumulated value as a statement credit toward bill reduction.
customerSituation: Customer visits the rewards overview on mobile to check current accumulated LBG coins and evaluate progress toward bill reduction.
storyTension: Ensuring the available balance translates transparently to guaranteed bill reduction without unnecessary gamified clutter.
customerResolution: Customer effortlessly verifies the balance and accesses direct statement credit redemption options.
primaryOutcome: Effortless verification of points value and direct access to payment-linked statement credit redemption.
prohibitedDetours: Promoting experiential vouchers or partner retail deals
completionSignals: Customer taps statement credit redemption option
